newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Barely changed European feeds start slow.
newsitem.headline: Barely changed European feeds start slow.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started the week slow with sellers offering most products unchanged to a touch lower following Friday's Chicago soymeal futures close and a stronger dollar, market sources said.
Bids were scarce no trades were reported during the early stages of the market.

"Mondays usually start calm. With a stronger dollar and USDA's acreage figures due this afternoon most buyers were expected to stay sidelined for most of the day," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
